titel: Trump’s DOJ Arrests an ICE Agent

faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Federal charges for an ICE agent, a deadlock in a high-profile trial, and college football
kurzfassung: Federal prosecutors charged an ICE agent with lying about a shooting in Minneapolis after video disproved his account. In Massachusetts, a murder trial involving postpartum psychosis faced continued deadlocks due to a holdout juror. Additionally, the SEC sued Louisiana State University over attempts to recruit current professional players back to college teams.
stichpunkte: An ICE agent was charged federally with making false statements regarding a shooting in Minneapolis.
The prosecutor leading the investigation was fired after disclosing plans to pursue stricter civil rights charges.
Jurors in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial declared themselves deadlocked for a second time.
The defense argued that a single holdout juror refused to follow the law on reasonable doubt.
Gloria Steinem shaped decades of feminism and co-founded Ms. magazine.
Steinem faced severe professional backlash after going undercover as a Playboy bunny.
The SEC sued Louisiana State University over efforts to recruit professional players into college football.
Recent rule changes allow student athletes extra eligibility, blurring the line between amateurs and pros.

clips.hook: First time federal prosecutors target an agent in an immigration crackdown
clips.text: Federal authorities took the unprecedented step of prosecuting one of their own personnel deployed during recent immigration operations.

clips.hook: A dramatic courtroom note exposes tension over jury instructions
clips.text: The jury foreperson reported that one member was unable to follow judicial guidelines, prompting heated arguments from the defense team.

clips.hook: Magazines denied female journalists bylines for major articles
clips.text: Major publications historically relegated women to researcher roles while men received credit as reporters for identical written work.

clips.hook: Why would professional athletes return to amateur sports?
clips.text: Even practice squad players earn substantial weekly wages, raising questions about the motivation to transition back to collegiate athletics.

clips.hook: Proposing strict campus conditions for returning athletes
clips.text: Athletes returning to college for financial gain should be required to fully integrate into student life by living in dorms and joining campus clubs.

beschreibung:
An ICE agent who allegedly shot a Venezuelan migrant in the leg and then lied about it surrenders to federal authorities. Defense attorneys for Lindsay Clancy ask a judge to dismiss the juror reportedly holding up an acquittal. And feminist icon Gloria Steinem dies at 92.
